payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over bus stops (2 to n) to compute and compare total time = bus time to stop + running time from stop to university.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks each stop after the first, which is a complete search, but no specific subtype like backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, graph search, or permutation enumeration matches the simple iterative loop. Forced to pick from given subtypes, search_backtracking is the most general, though inadequate.
